hero.headline:
Healing happens in the *golden hour*,
and we'll walk it with you.
hero.intro: A therapist-owned practice specializing in trauma, EMDR and substance use. Come as you are; leave with a little more room to breathe.

about.headline: A practice built around the person in the room.
about.intro: Golden Hour Wellness Colorado was founded by Shayla Martinez-O’Brien, a Licensed Professional Counselor with 11 years of clinical practice. What began as one clinician is now a small, hand-picked team.

services.headline: Specialized care, without the clinical chill.

team.headline: Three clinicians. Roughly 34 years of practice between them.

cta.headline: Your golden hour starts with one message.
